LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.label: Tempest
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.description: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated by using skills and can be spent to offset damage or unleash powerful abilities.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Tempest.comps.0.resourceDescriptio: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated by using skills and can be spent to offset damage or unleash powerful abilities.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.label: Elegance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.description: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated through combat and skill use, empowering her abilities and increasing Tempest recovery.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance.comps.0.resourceDescripti: Qinghe's special resource. It is accumulated through combat and skill use, empowering her abilities and increasing Tempest recovery.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreath.label: Long Breath
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreath.description: When Qinghe would take fatal damage or body-part-destroying damage, if she has any Tempest, that damage is negated, all injuries are repaired, Tempest is cleared, and she gains brief invulnerability and psychic invisibility.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreathDamageImmunity.label: Long Breath Surge
LanguageData.MX_QH_LongBreathDamageImmunity.descripti: A brief damage immunity granted after Long Breath triggers.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringRegen.label: Clear Flow
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringRegen.description: Automatically heals a small amount of injury every short interval.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusShield.label: Flower-God Ward
LanguageData.MX_QH_LotusShield.description: Qinghe is blessed by the Twelve Flower Gods and naturally generates a shield around herself. Higher Tempest increases damage absorbed per shield point; higher Elegance increases shield regeneration per second.\n\nWhen the shield breaks, it is disabled for 20 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QingheStatusGizmo.label: Qinghe Status Display
LanguageData.MX_QH_QingheStatusGizmo.description: Hidden hediff used to display Qinghe's status gizmo.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_DuanHunSlow.label: Soulbreak Drag
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_DuanHunSlow.description: Movement is dragged down by the Soulbreak melody.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunAlly.label: Yangchun Harmony
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunAlly.description: Bathed in Yangchun's musical intent, steps and mind are tuned into harmony.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunEnemy.label: Yangchun Suppression
LanguageData.MX_QH_Elegance_YangChunEnemy.description: Suppressed by the sound field; action rhythm is thrown into disorder.
LanguageData.MX_SpringFlow.label: Spring Flow Baptism
LanguageData.MX_SpringFlow.description: Blessed by Qinghe's Spring Flow, gaining improved offense, protection, and pain relief.
LanguageData.MX_AquaMirror.label: Mirror Bloom
LanguageData.MX_AquaMirror.description: Protected by Aqua Mirror. When the mirror disappears, it heals the bearer and retaliates against nearby enemies.
LanguageData.MX_Draining.label: Waterflow Severance
LanguageData.MX_Draining.description: Internal fluids are forcibly drawn out. Without intervention, death by dehydration will soon follow.
LanguageData.MX_DryCorpse.label: Dehydrated
LanguageData.MX_DryCorpse.description: A corpse drained of moisture. It will never rot or desiccate further, as if touched by some supernatural force.
LanguageData.MX_DehydrateDamage.label: Fluid Cycle Disorder
LanguageData.MX_DehydrateDamage.description: Some internal fluid behavior has been disrupted, causing circulatory failure or mechanical malfunction.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Desynced.label: Desynced
LanguageData.MX_QH_Desynced.description: Resonance from Qinghe's instrument disrupts movement and aiming rhythm, greatly reducing movement speed and shooting accuracy.
